bio.text: Lisa Demuth, a Republican from Cold Spring, is a candidate for Minnesota governor in 2026 and serves as Speaker of the Minnesota House.
She was first elected to the House in 2018, led the Republican minority in 2023 and 2024, and was elected speaker in 2025.
In her candidate survey response to KAXE, she said she served three terms on the ROCORI school board before entering the legislature and describes herself as a business owner.

sources.title: GOP Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth launches campaign for governor
